name: Witch Doctor Hexfire Adept transforms only the top Malefic Wrath rank (#12539)
contract: Report #12539: after Hexfire Wrath ends, Malefic Wrath on the action bar is replaced by a lower rank.
Malefic Wrath ranks are mana spells, so every learned rank stays active. SyncReplacements stood Hexfire
Wrath 807480 in for every known rank, and when Hexfire Ready 503626 ended the client got one
SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL per rank in hash order, so a lower rank could land on the button. The Volley and Hex
branches already transform only the top rank. Expected: Hexfire Adept 704500 transforms only the top rank
808876; the lower rank 807037 is never replaced, so it gets no supersede when the transform ends.

steps.label: Let login, spawn AI and level scaling settle
